applicationEvidence.reason: The real search rendered a source-qualified named-place and street/district/city context plus independent CI AGID ID. This is more detailed than the country and postcode layers, but the Photon result is ambiguous/Needs review and is not asserted as an authoritative building-footprint relation. The unmocked CI postal API failed closed and no postal Polygon/MultiPolygon or translucent postal overlay existed, matching the current no-postcode system.

limitations: Current no-postcode evidence excludes CI from postcode data creation.
Two-digit office codes, 104 and BP are delivery-address components, not postcode membership.
The detailed Photon result and AGID identity are independent context, not an authoritative building relation.
UPU and ARTCI references are not open bulk datasets.
Hugging Face, libpostal, OSM and the draft pack are not postal authority.
Deterministic rendering is not reported as manual visual inspection.
